ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a polar-projection-style schematic diagram of the terminator line, with a graticule inside the circle, and the terminator line is tangent to the polar circle at the point marked P. According to the positions of the meridians in the figure and the longitude labeling relationship, it can be read that the meridian where P is located is 135°W; point P is the tangent point between the terminator line and the polar circle, and judging by the tangent position of the terminator line for this solar term, the local time at P is 12:00. Then reason: Beijing time uses the local time zone standard of 120°E. 120°E and 135°W differ by 255°, and every 15° of longitude differs by 1 hour, so the time difference is 255°÷15°=17 hours. Beijing is located east of P, so Beijing time is 17 hours earlier than P. P is 12:00, so Beijing time is 12:00+17 hours=5:00 the next day. The question states that at this time London is Saturday, but Beijing is already Sunday, so the date in Beijing time should be Sunday. Therefore, at this time Beijing time is Sunday 5:00.

再推理：北京时间采用120°E的地方时区基准。120°E与135°W相差255°，经度每15°相差1小时，所以时间差为255°÷15°=17小时。北京位于P地以东，因此北京时间比P地早17小时。P地为12:00，则北京时间为12:00+17小时=次日5:00。题干说明此时伦敦为星期六，但北京已是星期日，因此北京时间的日期应为星期日。故此时北京时间为星期日5时。
